📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-16
1. Over 18% of Nvidia employees sign petition urging Jensen Huang's return產業
超過18%的Nvidia員工連署要求黃仁勳回鍋
Jensen Huang stepped down from all roles at Nvidia on Nov. 12 amid affair and Chinese spy allegations, and the board has opened an independent national-security investigation. Employees are now petitioning for his return.
黃仁勳捲入婚外情與中國間諜疑雲，11 月 12 日辭去 Nvidia 所有職務，董事會也啟動涉及國安的獨立調查。目前有員工連署要求他回鍋。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Google unveils Gemini 4 Hydrogen, 2.5x faster than its predecessor模型
Google公布Gemini 4 Hydrogen，比前代快2.5倍
Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov. 13, a lightweight model for everyday tasks that it says runs 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash. It is already rolling out to the Google app and Search.
Google 11 月 13 日公布適用日常工作的輕量級模型 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，強調速度比 3.8 Flash 快 2.5 倍，並已推向 Google App 與搜尋。
iThome · 原文連結
3. OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can pay on your behalf產品
OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet，讓AI代理人代購付款
Working with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, OpenAI's always-on agent Dots can now make payments once the user authorizes them. This extends AI agents into e-commerce transactions.
OpenAI 與美國運通、Mastercard、Visa 合作，讓常駐型 AI 代理人 Dots 在使用者授權後代為付款，把代理人能力延伸到電商交易。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Fireworks AI breach leads to malicious Anthropic Claude extension on Cursor marketplace資安
Fireworks AI事件波及，惡意版Anthropic Claude擴充程式於Cursor市集上架
Cursor said on Nov. 13 that the compromise of Fireworks AI, a platform it uses, put a malicious version of the Claude extension on its plugin marketplace and harmed users.
Cursor 11 月 13 日公告，所用的 Fireworks AI 平臺被駭，導致其外掛平臺出現惡意版 Claude 擴充程式，用戶因此受害。
iThome · 原文連結
5. FBI warns hackers use AI tool ARTEX to gain high privileges in under 3 hours資安
FBI警告駭客利用AI工具ARTEX加速入侵，部分事件不到3小時取得系統高權限
An FBI alert on Nov. 13 says multiple threat groups use the open-source AI pentesting tool ARTEX to find weaknesses, exploit them and steal data. In some incidents, going from target selection to elevated privileges took under three hours.
FBI 11 月 13 日發布警示，指出多個駭客組織利用開源 AI 滲透測試工具 ARTEX 自動找弱點、入侵並竊資，部分事件從鎖定目標到取得高權限不到 3 小時。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal政策
Nvidia間諜醜聞後，美國國會欲收緊AI晶片出口規定
After the scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, both Democrats and Republicans have voiced support for measures and bills that would further restrict AI chip exports.
在前 Nvidia 執行長黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜的醜聞後，民主、共和兩黨都表態支持更嚴格限制 AI 晶片出口的各項措施與法案。
The Verge · 原文連結
7. Microsoft 365 global outage lasts over 30 hours, blamed on a network upgrade flaw產業
微軟Microsoft 365全球當機逾30小時，禍因網路升級瑕疵
Microsoft says last week's outage, which hit Exchange Online, Teams and more, came from a flaw left by an earlier network capacity upgrade and triggered by a recent network change. It says the incident was unrelated to cyberattacks, AI or AI agents.
微軟說明，上週影響 Exchange Online、Teams 等服務的大當機，源於先前網路容量升級留下的瑕疵，在近期網路變更後被觸發，與網路攻擊、AI 或 AI 代理人無關。
iThome · 原文連結
8. A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice研究
朝著在晶格上定義標準模型邁進一步
OpenAI explores a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model and how GPT-6 Astra helped turn the idea into a detailed proof.
OpenAI 探討一種標準模型的非微擾晶格定義候選方案，並說明 GPT-6 Astra 如何協助把構想化為詳細證明。
OpenAI · 原文連結
9. Hackers use over 4,800 compromised GitHub accounts to probe 60,000 repos for cloud credentials資安
駭客利用逾4,800個遭入侵GitHub帳號，鎖定6萬個儲存庫竊取雲端憑證
Aikido Security disclosed the wfx-loot campaign: since Nov. 10, 4,837 accounts probed 61,764 repositories for write access, and at least 1,835 repos have run the malicious code. Attackers also quickly erase their traces after stealing credentials.
Aikido Security 揭露代號 wfx-loot 的攻擊：自 11 月 10 日起，4,837 個帳號探測 61,764 個儲存庫的寫入權限，至少 1,835 個已執行惡意程式，攻擊者竊取憑證後還會迅速清除紀錄。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health產品
Apple推出新App，研究人們如何使用AI處理健康問題
Apple's Health AI Usage Study, run with clinical AI platform OpenEvidence, aims to understand how people interact with conversational AI health tools and how useful the answers are. The app will answer everyday medical questions.
Apple 與臨床 AI 平臺 OpenEvidence 合作進行 Health AI Usage Study，了解人們如何使用對話式 AI 健康工具、回答是否有用，新 App 會回答日常醫療問題。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
